actionInsights.title: JavaScript Conceptual Gap
actionInsights.text: JavaScript is the cohort's lowest-scoring subject (33.2% avg vs 43.2% in HTML). Target remedial lab sessions on DOM manipulation, arrays, and functions before mid-terms.

actionInsights.title: 183 Students Below 50% Benchmark
actionInsights.text: 58.3% of examinees (183 students) scored under 50%. Setting up bi-weekly faculty doubt-clearing clinics will significantly reduce failure risk.

actionInsights.title: 27 Top Achievers Ready for Mentoring
actionInsights.text: 27 students scored ≥90% with 3 perfect 100% scores (Nimisha Rahal, Anmol Chauhan, Tanisha Agarwal). Organizing them into peer study group leads will accelerate batch progress.

actionInsights.title: Slot 2 Outperformed Slot 1 (+10.0 pts)
actionInsights.text: Slot 2 students averaged 45.3% compared to 35.3% in Slot 1, suggesting better afternoon readiness or varied section strengths across examination slots.
